message_and_information_structure_review.limitations: The offline helper assembles independent case/arm conversations. Actual provider isolation, complete untruncated history, immutable backend and access remain runtime gates; no successful real execution is asserted.

substantive_consistency_checks.reason: Displayed quadratic objective, monthly decimal units, nonnegative full-investment constraints, direct constrained gap, signed pair response error E and descriptive distance reduction G agree with the integration. No unrestricted loss identity is substituted.

The estimand is preservation of warranted institution mandate response under a fixed common model, jointly judged with each mandate objective and failures. It is not answer diversity alone and not a claim about common-model adoption or actual private forecasts. Shared errors can cancel in E, so joint institution losses remain essential as the documents require.

R1/R4 changes an onset/position/history-use policy bundle; FRESH is a separate one-step capability diagnostic. Before mandate arrival pending is allowed and there is no unique mandate-specific intermediate oracle score.

625 overlapping public-data windows, 1875 mandate cases, 3750 main final outputs and 16875 planned response calls are distinguished from independent observations. All windows and shared-optimum strata remain. Numeric contrasts use common validity masks and do not imply full-corpus superiority when failures are asymmetric.

Documents distinguish 1875 computed optima and 83 all-shared reference windows from AI observations. Config AI runs=0; workflow model_calls=0 and run_ready=false. Synthetic verification fixtures are explicitly labeled, temporary and not research results.
